posts.title: The Hardware Index - HWIDX
posts.description: I built HWIDX, the Hardware Index, to solve a practical problem I kept seeing with bare PCB designs. Projects from Adafruit, Micro:bit, Arduino, and others often have no case with space for a URL or other useful information.
